comment: Base script (DESKTOP-WASM-001 T7), written by `cobolt-bench pixel-parity --write-scripts`: every bound event raised once, in the order of the file, with a frame after each. Raised without waiting, as they open a form modally: none. Last, as they end the form (without waiting too when a modal form is open): Btn-Close.onClick. Answered with cancel, as they open a file dialog: Btn-Save.onClick, Lbl-Link.onClick. Not raised, as they reach the network: Cmb-Language.onSelectedIndexChanged, Tab-Main.onTabChanged, Tmr-Stack.onTick, Cmb-Region.onSelectedIndexChanged, Btn-Connect.onClick, Btn-Deploy.onClick, Tmr-Thumbs.onTick, Btn-CreateTable.onClick, Btn-NewPet.onClick, Btn-Reload.onClick, Dg-Pets.onCellClick, Cmb-Bucket.onSelectedIndexChanged, Btn-S3Reload.onClick, Btn-LamTry.onClick, Btn-Speak.onClick, Cmb-Ec2Region.onSelectedIndexChanged, Btn-Ec2Reload.onClick, Dg-Ec2.onCellEdited, Tmr-Ec2.onTick, Btn-Recognize.onClick.
